Simply target any Chicken and spam |cFFFFD700/chicken|r at it until it emotes at you. This will take about 100 emotes. (make a macro!)

Once it does, type /cheer with it targetted.

The Chicken will never turn friendly for a Horde player, even if they get the emote.
